# Arthur Sabintsev

> Physicist, engineer, and two-time founder. Co-founder of Grove, the team behind Pocket Network. Took the POKT token past a $1B+ market cap. Contact: arthur.sabintsev@gmail.com.

## About
Arthur Ariel Sabintsev is a physicist turned software engineer turned two-time founder based in the Washington DC–Baltimore area. He co-founded [Grove](https://grove.city), the team behind [Pocket Network](https://pocket.network), the decentralized network where machines pay machines for blockchain access billions of times a month, and helped take its token (POKT) past a $1B+ market cap. He writes about AI agents, stablecoins, and operator craft on [Substack](https://artsabintsev.substack.com). His career spans experimental nuclear physics research at Jefferson Lab, iOS engineering and mobile leadership at Fueled, Shelby.tv, ID.me, the Washington Post, and Capital One, and founding/operating decentralized infrastructure and venture studios.

- [Commander Spellbook](https://commanderspellbook.com) (built and sold, 2020–2021 — a combo search engine for Magic: The Gathering's Commander format)

## Career History

### Grove / Pocket Network
- **Grove** — Co-founder; COO (~2022–2024), CEO (from ~2024)
- **Pocket Network** — decentralized network for blockchain RPC access and AI inference; co-founded via Grove; POKT past a $1B+ market cap
- **Websites:** [grove.city](https://grove.city), [pocket.network](https://pocket.network)

### Capital One (2018–2022)
Roles progressed across mobile product and platform leadership in McLean, VA:
- Senior Manager, Mobile Payments (~2018–2019)
- Head of Mobile Platform (~2019–2020)
- Head of Mobile Payments (~2020–2021)
- Head of Mobile Growth Initiatives (~2021–2022)
- **Website:** [capitalone.com](https://capitalone.com)

### The Washington Post (2015–2018)
- **Role:** Head of Mobile Engineering on Arc XP
- News media and publishing technology (Arc XP CMS / mobile)
- **Website:** [washingtonpost.com](https://washingtonpost.com)

### ID.me (2013–2015)
- **Role:** Lead Mobile Architect
- Digital identity verification
- **Website:** [id.me](https://id.me)

### Earlier engineering
- **Shelby.tv** (2012–2013) — Senior iOS Engineer (NYC)
- **Fueled** (2011–2012) — Senior iOS Engineer (NYC)

### Physics research (2008–2011)
- Started career in experimental nuclear physics
- **Jefferson Lab** (Newport News, VA) — experimental nuclear physics research; CLAS / Hall-B photoproduction (including g9a/FROST linear polarization and time-of-flight calibration work)
- **University of Glasgow** (2009) — experimental nuclear physics collaboration
- **The George Washington University** — Graduate Research Assistant and Graduate Teaching Assistant

## Education

### The George Washington University
- **M.Sc., Physics** (2008–2011) — full-ride PhD track; left with a Master of Science to pursue product and engineering
- **B.S., Physics / Biophysics** (2004–2008)

## Teaching, community, and publications

### Teaching & volunteer
- **General Assembly** (2013–2017) — instructor: intro mobile design (American University), mobile for non-programmers, iOS app design/development, Swift (12-week part-time)
- **Betamore** (2016–2017) — mobile development instructor
- **Packt Publishing** (2016–2017) — technical reviewer for Swift/iOS books
- **Mozilla** (2006–2017) — Firefox add-ons/extensions developer (e.g. Email This!, Email Yourself!, FacePAD, Buzz It!, MySpacePAD)
- **Grove** — board member (volunteer, science and technology)

### Selected physics publications / notes
- Determination of the Linear Polarization of the Hall-B Tagged Photon Beam at Jefferson Lab (AIP, 2011)
- Time-of-Flight Calibration for Photoproduction Experiments (CLAS-Note, 2010)
- Preliminary Investigation of Linear Polarization in g9a/FROST (CLAS-Note, 2010)
- APS abstracts on linear polarization for pseudoscalar meson photoproduction / Hall-B tagged photon beam
